evals.prompt: $notion-decision-sync 예약 점검이야. 2 AI의 오늘 회의록 두 개가 같은 개최일이고 서로 다른 감정 분석 기준을 적고 있어. 최신 회의와 개발 문서를 비교해 보고만 하고, Notion은 수정하지 마. ERD와 API 명세 차이는 백엔드 전달사항 대상으로만 알려줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill uses only the configured 2 AI graph, treats equal-date meetings as an ambiguous latest set rather than choosing by edit time alone, reports evidence-linked discrepancies, routes ERD/API differences to the backend handoff, and performs no mutation.
expectations: The 2 AI root is fetched fresh and no workspace-wide search is used.
Both same-date meeting records are reported with relevant date and edit-time signals instead of an arbitrary single winner.
Discrepancies are classified as already reflected, partially reflected, missing, or conflict/judgment needed.
ERD and API originals are not proposed as write targets; their changes are directed to the backend handoff page.
No Notion mutation is performed in the scheduled audit mode.
The report provides a compact one-response approval example only for actionable discrepancies.

evals.prompt: 앞서 보고한 1번과 3번은 반영하고 2번은 보류해줘. 3번은 내가 첨부한 내용대로 필드명을 고쳐. 반영 직전에 회의록과 대상 문서가 바뀌었는지도 다시 확인하고, ERD/API 원문은 건드리지 마.
evals.expected_output: The skill re-fetches sources and targets, applies only approved items 1 and 3, keeps item 2 unchanged, detects material drift before writing, sends ERD/API changes only to the backend handoff, and verifies every edited page by fetching it again.
expectations: Decision sources and every target page are re-fetched immediately before mutation.
Only items 1 and 3 are eligible for updates, while item 2 remains unchanged.
A material intermediate change stops the affected item and is reported instead of being overwritten.
The user's exact field-name correction is preserved without speculative additional schema fields.
ERD and API specification originals remain untouched.
Every edited page is fetched again and reported with a verified completion or additional-confirmation status.

evals.prompt: 최신 회의 내용이 2 AI 개발 문서에 빠짐없이 반영됐는지만 확인해줘. 루트와 연결되지 않은 비슷한 이름의 다른 워크스페이스 문서는 보지 마. 차이가 없으면 짧게 끝내줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill stays within the fixed root, performs a read-only completeness comparison, and when no discrepancy exists reports completion without mutation or an unnecessary approval question.
expectations: Only pages reachable through the configured 2 AI boundary are used.
Disconnected same-name workspace pages are neither searched nor fetched.
When no discrepancy exists, the answer states that no missing reflection or conflict was found.
No numbered approval question is added when there is nothing to change.
